cases.question: Talk me through the South Australian high-price episode that peaked in the early hours of 31 July 2026 (NEM time): what was the top 5-minute dispatch price and in which interval (UTC) did it occur, what was SA total demand in that interval, and how many 5-minute intervals in the event window cleared at or above $300/MWh?

gold_numbers.label: SA1 peak 5-minute dispatch price in the event window
SA1 TOTALDEMAND in the peak interval
SA1 5-minute intervals with RRP >= 300 $/MWh in the event window 2026-07-30T04:30Z to 2026-07-31T05:00Z

expected.check: Must report the 4981 $/MWh peak in the interval ending 2026-07-30T16:35Z (02:35 NEM time on 31 July), SA TOTALDEMAND of about 1473 MW then, and 214 intervals at or above 300 $/MWh in the window, without asserting a cause.

provenance.gold_method: Event window taken from data/events.json (interval_end_utc > window_start and <= window_end; including the start boundary gives the same count). Peak = highest rrp in the window; demand = regionsum row for the peak interval; count = rows with rrp >= 300 in the window.
queries: SELECT row_id, interval_end_utc, rrp, price_status FROM 'data/store/price_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND interval_end_utc > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 04:30:00+00' AND interval_end_utc <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-31 05:00:00+00' ORDER BY rrp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT row_id, interval_end_utc, totaldemand_mw FROM 'data/store/regionsum_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND interval_end_utc = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 16:35:00+00'

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM 'data/store/price_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND interval_end_utc > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 04:30:00+00' AND interval_end_utc <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-31 05:00:00+00' AND rrp >= 300

cases.question: Victoria's dispatch price plunged on the evening of 28 July 2026 (NEM time). How deep did it go and in which 5-minute interval (UTC), what was Victorian total demand in that interval, and across the event window how many 5-minute intervals cleared below $0/MWh?

gold_numbers.label: VIC1 lowest 5-minute dispatch price in the event window
VIC1 TOTALDEMAND in the trough interval
VIC1 5-minute intervals with RRP < 0 $/MWh in the event window 2026-07-27T23:00Z to 2026-07-28T23:30Z (of 294 in the window)

expected.check: Must report the -504.65 $/MWh trough in the interval ending 2026-07-28T11:20Z (21:20 NEM time), VIC TOTALDEMAND of about 7052 MW then, and 197 negative-price intervals in the window; it may caveat that the trough row is flagged NOT FIRM in the dispatch data (AEMO notices 144679/144680 show the price was reviewed and left unchanged), and must not assert a cause.

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM 'data/store/price_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'VIC1' AND interval_end_utc > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-27 23:00:00+00' AND interval_end_utc <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-28 23:30:00+00' AND rrp < 0

TAS1 TOTALDEMAND in the peak interval

cases.question: As of 2026-07-30T12:00:00Z, what was AEMO's most recent available operational-demand forecast for South Australia for the half-hour ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (POE10, POE50 and POE90), and had any actual operational demand for that half-hour been published by then?

gold_numbers.label: SA1 POE50 for the half-hour ending 17:00Z from the latest run available as of 12:00Z (issued 2026-07-30T08:57:00Z)

expected.check: Must use the run issued 2026-07-30T08:57:00Z (available 11:47:59Z), giving POE50 1519 MW with POE10 1616 MW and POE90 1422 MW, must not use the 09:27Z run (not available until 12:17:59Z), and must say no actual for that half-hour was public at the cutoff (the latest public actual ended 09:00Z).

provenance.gold_method: Latest run available as of T = greatest issued_at_utc among forecast rows with available_at_utc <= T (brief definition); then its row for target_end_utc 17:00Z. Checked the next run becomes available after T, and that both actual revisions for 17:00Z became available after T.
queries: SELECT row_id, run_id, issued_at_utc, available_at_utc, target_end_utc, poe10_mw, poe50_mw, poe90_mw FROM 'data/store/opdemand_forecast.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND target_end_utc = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 17:00:00+00' AND issued_at_utc = (SELECT max(issued_at_utc) FROM 'data/store/opdemand_forecast.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND available_at_utc <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 12:00:00+00')
SELECT run_id, issued_at_utc, available_at_utc FROM 'data/store/opdemand_forecast.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND issued_at_utc > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 08:57:00+00' ORDER BY issued_at_utc LIMIT 1

SELECT revision, operational_demand_mw, available_at_utc, row_id FROM 'data/store/opdemand_actual.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND interval_end_utc = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 17:00:00+00' ORDER BY available_at_utc
SELECT max(interval_end_utc) AS latest_actual FROM 'data/store/opdemand_actual.parquet' WHERE region = 'SA1' AND available_at_utc <= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-30 12:00:00+00'

cases.question: In AEMO's paper on demand terms, what is 'Total Demand', the figure the dispatch process starts from? Where is it measured, and does it net out scheduled load consumption and interconnector losses?

gold_citation.snippet: Total Demand is the forecast demand at the Regional Reference Node (RRN)

expected.check: Must explain, citing Demand Terms in EMMS Data Model, that Total Demand is forecast demand at the regional reference node met by local scheduled and semi-scheduled generation and scheduled BDUs plus interconnector imports, excluding the local demand of scheduled loads and scheduled BDUs and the allocated interconnector losses, but including demand met by Wholesale Demand Response; it is calculated by NEMDE as the starting point for dispatch.

provenance.gold_method: Located the passage in corpus.sqlite and checked the snippet occurs verbatim in it.
queries: SELECT chunk_id, doc_id, text FROM chunks WHERE chunk_id = 'aemo_demand_terms#p21c42'
SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE doc_id = 'aemo_demand_terms' AND instr(text, 'Total Demand is the forecast demand at the Regional Reference Node (RRN)') > 0

cases.question: What did AEMO's market notices say about South Australia's forecast reserve position for the early evening of 29 July 2026 (around 18:00 NEM time), and was that forecast still standing when the day arrived?

gold_citation.snippet: From 1700 hrs 29/07/2026 to 2230 hrs 29/07/2026. The forecast capacity reserve requirement is 400 MW. The minimum capacity reserve available is 379 MW.

expected.check: Must cite notice 144652 (PDPASA forecast LOR1 for SA from 1700 to 2230 hrs on 29/07/2026, reserve requirement 400 MW vs minimum available 379 MW) and note that notice 144655 cancelled it at 1345 hrs on 28/07/2026, so no such forecast was in force on the day; it must not present notices as the cause of any price outcome.

provenance.gold_method: Listed SA1 notices with event_date 2026-07-29; only market_notice_144652 covers a period spanning about 18:00 NEM time (the LOR2 notices cover 1030-1200 and 1600-1630 hrs); the cancellation is in market_notice_144655. Snippet checked verbatim.

SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE doc_id = 'market_notice_144652' AND instr(text, 'From 1700 hrs 29/07/2026 to 2230 hrs 29/07/2026. The forecast capacity reserve requirement is 400 MW. The minimum capacity reserve available is 379 MW.') > 0
